snippet.title: Underbloom - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Underbloom – Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up.

Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

● Game: Underbloom
● Developer: Creamhouse
● Genre: Incremental Game, Casual, Simulation, Incremental
● Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5340870/
Release status: Coming Soon - Planned release: 17 Nov, 2026
